title: : Tech Support II : Foamy The Squirrel
description: A second call to Tech Support just causes more problems.  illwillpress.com

asr.full_text: Hello, welcome to Smell Tech Support. How may I help you? Yeah, I saw this commercial that said your tech support is 24-7, 365 days a year. Is that true? My God, I'm here all year long. What do you mean, I'm here all year long? It is just me here, 24-7, 365 days a year. Wait a second, so the Smell Company outsourced all their tech support jobs and gave them to one Indian guy? Yes, I thought they were out of their minds as well, but apparently I'm very versatile. Dude, how do you sleep? I take little naps while you're on hold. For the love of... Is that why I was waiting 45 minutes for someone to pick up the phone? Yes, it was nappy time. My seat is also a toilet, so I don't have to get up to go poopy. Well, that's just swell. You know, tech support here gets a break, like, every 15 minutes,. To stretch and look away from the computer screen. What is break? Uh, it's when you stop working for a little while. Stop working? I do not understand. What you're doing now? Stop doing it for like five minutes. That is a very odd concept, these breaks. Your country is very different from ours. Do you also have monkey with shocky stick who hit you when you not work fast enough? What the? Shocky monkey? My indebted, indebtedness! Is there anything else I can help you with today, sir? Nah, talking to you has been more than enough to reinvigorate my appreciation for my country and all its freedoms. There is no need to rub it in, you American bastards! Shouldn't you be working right now? I'll live, what is indebtedness? Damn, I want a shocky monkey. My god, he did amazing thing to go crazy. You.
